hypotheses.description: Return zero hypotheses when no concrete cause is supported; otherwise return exactly one narrow, best-supported root cause. Never list speculative alternatives. A traceback truncated before its terminal exception does not support a hypothesis.

code.description: Classify only after extracting the concrete cause. Use external_service_failure for an explicit remote HTTP 5xx response; dependency_unavailable for reachability, DNS, TLS, refusal, reset, or deadline failures; dependency_missing for an absent module, executable, file, library, or symbol; access_denied for authorization, permission, or read-only failures; environment_mismatch for missing environment values or occupied listen addresses; transient_infrastructure only for a separate explicit temporary signal such as rate limiting or deadlock; resource_pressure only for explicit exhaustion or limits; application_defect only for implementation faults. Select the narrowest authorized code; unknown_target_error is a last resort.

summary.description: A concise, issue-specific headline derived from artifact.content. Preserve any endpoint or port, named command, path, setting, rejected value, and short diagnostic phrase that distinguishes the incident. Never say that a traceback, panic stack, exception chain, signature, bounded log, or error is present; never merely restate invalid input, target failure, or nonzero exit.

root_cause.description: The deepest concrete condition supported by runtime artifact content. Preserve every material terminal exception branch or validation item plus the distinguishing operation, source location, endpoint, path, command, setting, or rejected value. Do not compress concrete diagnostic details to a taxonomy label.

explanation.description: Connect the supported root cause to the outer target failure or affected operation. Preserve both sides of every stated cause chain; if no additional path exists, repeat root_cause. Omit Jobman mechanics and schema instructions.

supporting_evidence.description: The smallest set of distinct supplied artifact or attributed-enrichment IDs that directly supports this hypothesis. Cite the target content that contains the cause, never generic exit code, outcome, timestamp, counter, or resource-usage metadata.

contradicting_evidence.description: Must be empty. Generated causes supplement authoritative deterministic facts rather than disputing them.

contradicts_findings.description: Must be empty. Generated causes supplement authoritative deterministic findings rather than disputing them.
